newsitem.title: CHINA: Gore says China President to visit U.S. this year.
newsitem.headline: Gore says China President to visit U.S. this year.

text.p: U.S. Vice President Al Gore said on Wednesday that Chinese President Jiang Zemin would visit the United States in the autumn of this year.
The two sides were now beginning to work on setting specific dates, he said.
Gore said his talks with Jiang on Wednesday had lasted far longer than scheduled.
Jiang, who is also chief of China's ruling Communist Party had greeted Gore in upbeat style before the meeting, saying the past two days had been very productive.
"Our discussions were productive, friendly, searching and above all wide-ranging," Gore said of his meeting with Jiang.

The U.S. vice president's four-day visit to China has been hailed as providing a vital boost to the long-strained Sino-U.S. relationship and paving the way towards an exchange of visits by Jiang and U.S. President Bill Clinton. Clinton is expected to visit China sometime in 1998.
